baseline.label: Core Engine Baseline
baseline.summary: Compact 24B flat-arena nodes, lazy expansion, flat AMAF pool, xoshiro256**, O(1) edge-bitmask Union-Find, 2-ply subtree reuse, 8,784 exhaustive dead-cell pruning, variance-capped GRAVE-TS (ancestor cap=32).

accepted_progression.label: MCTS-Solver + Mustplay
accepted_progression.changes: NODE_PROVEN_WIN/LOSS propagation + 1-ply win / double-threat loss / single-threat mustplay (0 false positives across 3x3 minimax)

accepted_progression.label: Two-Distance Potential (depth<=2)
accepted_progression.changes: Exact 4-direction bucket-queue Two-Distance connectivity heuristic on Hex component graph applied at shallow expansions (depth<=2)

accepted_progression.label: Lock-Free Shared-Tree Parallel
accepted_progression.changes: Atomic NODE_EXPANDING claim, acquire-release publish, virtual loss (2.0*vl), unified shared tree (320k-646k iters/s on 8 threads)

accepted_progression.changes: 216 canonical 4-way symmetric 6-ring patterns trained via convex L-BFGS-B on 10,547 self-play moves (Val Top-1 49.81%, Top-5 71.16%, temp=0.35)

accepted_progression.label: Nash Opening Book + Pondering
accepted_progression.changes: Empirically calibrated 11x11 50.0% Nash pie-rule opening book (0.00s) & swap contour, Two-Distance depth<=4, lock-free opponent-turn Pondering

accepted_progression.label: Exact VC-Solver + MoHex Tuning
accepted_progression.changes: Exact Disjoint-Carrier Virtual Connection Solver & VC-Mustplay (0 false positives across all 19,683 3x3 boards), Box-Muller Beta (alpha>=16), prior_weight=8, rave_bias=0.0005, expand_threshold=8

rejected_ablations.root_cause: Uncapped ancestor AMAF pseudo-counts collapsed Beta posterior variance in Thompson Sampling; capping borrowed pseudo-counts at 32 flipped it to 56.7%.
100% deterministic last-good-reply correlated playouts and biased AMAF/RAVE value estimates.
Running 4-direction Dijkstra on deep leaves cut throughput by -18%; gating to shallow depths recovered speed and jumped to 68.0%.
Overly greedy Boltzmann rollout reduced AMAF exploration diversity compared to temp=0.35 (57.5%).
Forcing 100% deterministic edge responses wasted rollout tempo on dead edge cells, corrupting AMAF estimates.
Despite +4.96%p Top-1 validation accuracy, evaluating Bridge-6 per rollout step cut throughput by -34.7% (43.0k vs 65.8k iters/move).
Despite +19% higher throughput, bounded negative-kurtosis tails weakened Thompson Sampling exploration; exact Box-Muller at alpha>=16 preserved full strength.
Even with +35% more iterations, GRAVE-UCB lost decisively to variance-capped GRAVE-TS posterior sampling.
